description: Source code for the AndroidSdkType class, which extends JavaDependentSdkType and implements JavaSdkType. It manages Android SDK validation, setup, and integration within an IDE environment, including SDK path validation, SDK creation, and icon provisioning.

classes.name: AndroidSdkType
classes.description: Manages Android SDK validation, setup, and integration within an IDE environment, including SDK path validation, SDK creation, and icon provisioning.

methods.name: getBinPath
methods.description: Returns the binary path for the given SDK.

methods.name: getToolsPath
methods.description: Returns the tools path for the given SDK.

methods.name: getVMExecutablePath
methods.description: Returns the VM executable path for the given SDK.

methods.name: suggestHomePath
methods.description: Suggests a home path for SDK installation (returns null).

methods.name: isValidSdkHome
methods.description: Checks if the provided path is a valid Android SDK home.

methods.name: validateAndroidSdk
methods.description: Validates whether a given path belongs to a valid Android SDK, checking existence and presence of platforms.

methods.name: getVersionString
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the SDK.

methods.name: suggestSdkName
methods.description: Suggests a name for the SDK based on current name and home path.

methods.name: setupSdkPaths
methods.description: Sets up SDK paths, including Java SDKs and Android targets, and handles SDK creation dialog.

methods.name: createAdditionalDataConfigurable
methods.description: Creates a configurable UI component for additional SDK data.

methods.name: saveAdditionalData
methods.description: Saves additional SDK data to XML element.

methods.name: loadAdditionalData
methods.description: Loads additional SDK data from XML element.

methods.name: getPresentableName
methods.description: Returns the user-friendly name of the SDK type.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon representing the SDK type.

methods.name: getIconForAddAction
methods.description: Returns the icon used for adding SDK actions.

methods.name: getDefaultDocumentationUrl
methods.description: Provides the default documentation URL for the SDK.

methods.name: getInternalJavaSdk
methods.description: Retrieves the internal Java SDK associated with the Android SDK.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AndroidSdkType.
